notes: The וְהָיָה frame's complementizer was placed on the first 'that' in the verse, which is the relative of the temporal clause 'in the day that he causeth his sons to inherit' and belongs to the infinitive construct under rule 52; the apodosis 'that' at t019, which is the frame's, was left as an added unit. DEU.21.3 aligns the same frame with its complementizer on the apodosis, so this is one construction analysed two ways with nothing in the source licensing the difference. Corrected: הָיָה takes t019 discontinuously (rules 25, 45), הַנְחִיל takes t008, and the added unit is removed.
